mentions.name: Calendar for car navigation system (e39.dev)
mentions.description: A custom calendar application for the author's car navigation system. It wraps Akonadi with a DBus shim and consumes that data model in custom calendar widgets and UX designed for a rotary knob interface, with plans to also run the same app on an Intel Atom tablet mounted on a fridge using a Griffin PowerMate for input.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Im building a calendar for my car navigation system https://e39.dev

Last winter I built a Matrix client for it. This time around I want to wrap Akonadi with a DBus shim and consume that model in custom calendar widgets and UX I’m making for a rotary knob ui.

I want to run the same app on an intel atom tablet on the side of my fridge, with a Griffin PowerMate hooked up to it for input.
